body:
<!-- kb: {"priority":2} -->
## Why
`engines: ">=20"` promises a Node line nodejs.org lists as end-of-life, and the store that track A builds needs `node:sqlite`, which does not exist on 20 (`docs/local-first.md` §1 item 7, §9, §11). The code carries JSDoc nobody checks.

## What
1. `package.json`: `engines.node` → `">=22.13"`; add `typescript` as a **devDependency** only (no lockfile is committed today — keep it that way, and keep `package-manager-cache: false` in CI); add `"typecheck": "tsc --noEmit"` and run it from `npm run lint` after the existing `node --check` loop.
2. `tsconfig.json`: `allowJs`, `checkJs`, `noEmit`, `module: nodenext`, `target: es2022`, `strict: false`, include `bin/**/*.js`, `src/**/*.js`, `scripts/**/*.mjs`. Fix the annotations the check rejects; where a fix is not a one-liner, a `// @ts-expect-error <why>` with a reason is acceptable. Do not change runtime behaviour to satisfy the checker.
3. `bin/hkb.js`: before any import, the warning filter from §9 verbatim (silences only the `node:sqlite` ExperimentalWarning; every other warning still prints).
4. `.github/workflows/test.yml`: the `test` job on 22 and 24 (a matrix is fine now: two floors is a real signal), the `smoke` job on 22 and 26 (the floor and the current line); update the comment that says "On Node 20 on purpose".
5. Wording: `CLAUDE.md` value 1 "any harness drives it through `gh`" → "any harness drives it through `hkb` verbs; GitHub is the default store today and becomes a bridge (ADR-006)"; `README.md`'s "Before you start" Node line → ">= 22.13, 24 recommended".

## Done when
- [ ] `npm run lint` runs the type check and is green; `npm test` green.
- [ ] `node -e "process.emitWarning('x', 'ExperimentalWarning')"` through `bin/hkb.js`'s filter still prints, and the SQLite one does not (a unit test in `test/cli.test.js` that spawns `bin/hkb.js version` on this Node and asserts an empty stderr is enough).
- [ ] CI green on all four jobs.
- [ ] No line in CLAUDE.md or README.md still says a harness drives hkb "through gh" or that the floor is 20.

## Contract
Keep `npm run lint`'s `node --check` loop as-is (a later card replaces it when the sources become `.ts`). The devDependency must not be needed to *run* hkb from a clone: `node bin/hkb.js version` in a fresh clone without `npm install` still works.

**Read first:** `docs/local-first.md` (the plan; the sections named below), `docs/wiki/decisions/adr-005-control-plane.md`,
`docs/wiki/decisions/adr-006-local-store.md`, `CLAUDE.md`. Keep it dependency-free at runtime. Pure logic in
`src/model.js` with a test. Errors name the fix and carry `.exitCode`. `--json` everywhere. Update the wiki page a
change touches (`node .repolore/scripts/wiki-check.mjs` lists what went stale); a new feature gets a new page.
Finish with `npm run lint && npm test` green, one draft PR, and exactly one terminal verb.
goal: engines >=22.13; npm run typecheck green; CI runs lint+test on 22 and 24, smoke on 22 and 26; bin/hkb.js carries the warning filter; CLAUDE.md and README no longer say a harness drives hkb through gh
title: Node floor 22.13 with the SQLite warning silenced, CI on 22/24/26, the JSDoc type check, the wording
